## 🚀 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If you are proposing a new flow builder node, describe its inputs, configuration fields, and outputs.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or examples of other tools with similar functionality.
